description: This file provides utility functions and classes for handling dates and times in Excel files, including conversions between Excel serial date numbers and Python datetime objects, as well as handling Excel's date quirks and errors.

classes.name: XLDateError
classes.description: Base class for all datetime-related errors in xlrd.

classes.name: XLDateNegative
classes.description: Error indicating an Excel date value is less than 0.00.

classes.name: XLDateAmbiguous
classes.description: Error related to the 1900 leap-year problem in Excel date handling.

classes.name: XLDateTooLarge
classes.description: Error indicating a date exceeds the year 9999 in Excel.

classes.name: XLDateBadDatemode
classes.description: Error when datemode argument is invalid (not 0 or 1).

methods.name: xldate_as_tuple
methods.description: Converts an Excel serial date to a Gregorian tuple (year, month, day, hour, minute, second).

methods.name: xldate_as_datetime
methods.description: Converts an Excel serial date to a Python datetime object.

methods.name: xldate_from_date_tuple
methods.description: Converts a Gregorian date tuple to an Excel serial date.

methods.name: xldate_from_time_tuple
methods.description: Converts a time tuple to an Excel fractional day value.

methods.name: xldate_from_datetime_tuple
methods.description: Converts a datetime tuple to an Excel serial date.
